long_biography.plain_text:
Topçuoğlu entered Gülsan's family businesses after university and formally joined Gülsan Sentetik in 1983. He advanced through operating departments and sales management before taking a board seat. When his uncle Naci died, he assumed the chairmanship in 2008, taking leadership of a manufacturer already established in polypropylene sacks, carpet yarn and nonwoven fabrics.

His chairmanship broadened the industrial platform. Gülsan added hygiene-film capacity, expanded spunbond production into Egypt and developed further plants in Turkey, while renewable power grew through hydroelectric, wind and biomass projects. The group now combines large-scale yarn, packaging and hygiene-material production with energy, automotive and construction interests. Topçuoğlu also chairs Topçuoğlu Holding and Gülsan Sentetik.
